label: run124 storage-AS keeper
definition: NEW KEEPER. run121 + --storage-as-commitment: reserves the measured hourly storage up-AS MW (RegUp+RRS+ECRS, per-resource-type series; Reg-Down/NonSpin excluded) from the battery dispatch power cap, so AS-committed capacity cannot also arbitrage energy. CT deployment OFF, battery_dispatch_adder=10 retained. Adopted for ACCURACY, not fit (same 5 fails @0.5% / cf_emd 18/18 / CO2 8/9 as run121): caps the energy-only LP's unphysical full-fleet peak dump — 2024 storage 0.781->0.728 TWh (EIA-930 0.722) and peak 5.93->4.59 GW; 12 unphysical >4.6 GW dump hours eliminated. The adder disciplines throughput (energy), the AS reservation disciplines the peak (power) — complementary, not double-counted (adder=0 explodes storage to 2.72 TWh). 2023 storage-AS is an ESTIMATE (intensity transfer from 2024); 2024/25 measured.
